basic_info.description: Cozy 3-bedroom home in Miraloma Park with all the Right touches! Features: updated kitchen with rich cherry cabinetry, top-of-the-line Samsung stainless appliances and great counterspace ample space for meal prep. Abundant natural light from 4 skylights through the living quarters including kitchen and upper bathroom, Formal dining area looking out to spacious rear deck perfect for the outdoor living. Updated bathroom with Jacuzzi tub perfect for unwinding after a long day. Dual pane windows throughout and a gas fireplace in the living room. Two spacious bedrooms up. Downstairs in an unwarranted large bedroom/studio with separate kitchen and bath including newer luxury plank flooring, granite countertops and 2 oversized closets perfect for in-laws coming to visit or seniors who do not like stairs. Great deck off the kitchen and stairs to the top of the yard with a spacious upper deck area perfect for meditation or outdoor planting.  Ideal Location in Miraloma Park with no neighbors across the street for more parking and just a stone's throw from Mollie Stone's. Neighborhood is family-friendly, with schools just down the street, plus plenty of parks and shops to explore. Freeways are easy to access for commuters and a short drive from Glen Park, Noe Valley, and West Portal.
